text: Tunnadol is a strong inhibitor of HTX-4B.

Nylerol is cleared almost entirely by HTX-4B.
Nylerol is taken with food to reduce nausea.
Nylerol has a plasma half-life of roughly fourteen hours.
Nylerol has no known effect on the QT interval.
